I am thinking about this year same as last year. Nothing big changed, so I do what I did before. My man and me, we been farming this 7 mu for many years. Two boys work in the city now, send some money home, but the land is still our living.

I split my land like this: 5 mu for wheat then maize after, and 2 mu for peanut in the spring. The peanut ground is the sandier piece near the road, wheat don't do so good there but peanut likes it loose.

**Wheat (5 mu, winter):**
I plant in October after the maize comes off. I buy the improved seed from the same shop in town, about 15 kg per mu, a bit thick because if some don't come up I still have enough. For fertilizer I put down 2 bags of compound fertilizer (复合肥, the 15-15-15 kind) per mu before plowing — that's 50 kg per mu. Then in spring when the wheat is greening up (返青) I spread one bag of urea per mu, 25 kg. That gives about 17 kg nitrogen, 7.5 phosphorus, 7.5 potassium per mu. I water 3 times — before winter, at greening, and when the head is filling. I spray 2 times, one for the aphids and one mixed spray for rust and worms. Last year I got about 450 kg per mu, should be similar.

**Maize (5 mu, summer):**
After wheat harvest in June I plant the hybrid seed right away, no plowing, just the machine pushes the seed in. Everybody here uses Zhengdan or one of those hybrid — the seed man tells me which is selling good. I put one bag compound fertilizer at planting, 25 kg per mu, then topdress urea when it's waist-high, 30 kg per mu. That's maybe 18 kg N, 4 P, 4 K. I water once if the rain is short, sometimes twice. One spray for the corn borer. Yield last year was close to 550 kg per mu.

**Peanut (2 mu, spring):**
I plant in late April. I save some seed from last year plus buy a little to freshen it — the improved kind. I plow this ground because peanut needs loose soil. I put 1.5 bags compound fertilizer per mu, about 35 kg, and a little urea, maybe 10 kg per mu. Peanut don't need so much nitrogen, my mother always said peanut makes its own. But I add phosphate because my neighbor told me it helps the pods fill. I water 2 times, at flowering and pod-setting. Spray 2 times for the leaf spot. Peanut gives me about 280 kg per mu, and the price is better than maize so the 2 mu is worth it.

I don't have money to waste but I also can't afford a bad harvest — 6 mouths and the boys' wages only go so far. I put a little extra fertilizer because losing yield hurts more than the cost of one more bag.
